items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: in the personnel of that band that made those recordings there was George Hudson, Crack Stanley and Merle

ctx.x: Anyway, we came back. And we spent several days down in Batangas, and back to Manilla. WE played in and around Manilla. We had a regular stage area where all the USO personnel lived. But everybody was billetted, men on one side of the barbed wire fence, and women on the other side. You come in at nights, you had a big gambling casino. And my brother, the great gambler, my brother, the great gambler, was always broke. He ain't never won nothing. He and Crack Stanley were supposed to have been two of the greatest…
